# cloudsmith_api_key_rule (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization to which this rule belongs.
- `rule_type` (String) The account types this rule applies to. One of: 'Service Accounts', 'User Accounts'.

### Optional

- `enforce_refresh` (Boolean, Deprecated) Deprecated compatibility setting. Automatic API key refresh is no longer supported; must be false or omitted.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether this rule is currently active and enforced.
- `max_age_hours` (Number) The maximum permitted age of an API key, in hours. API keys older than this lose access until refreshed. Omit to disable the age limit.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the rule was created at.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_applied_at` (String) The last time this rule was evaluated and applied by the expiry task.
- `slug` (String) Human-readable identifier, generated from the rule type.
- `slug_perm` (String) An auto-generated id that uniquely identifies the rule.
- `updated_at` (String) The time the rule was last updated at.
